notes: Three of the five Contradicted claims are in the triage area (P21, M1-1, M3-2), so they decide the verdict. All rest on one fact: the app's screening flow (MainActivity.kt:523-571) throws away the capture and returns a fixed NO_FURTHER_ACTION result (estimate 8.2-10.1, threshold 12.0) without calling ScreeningPipelineUseCase or the triage engine. It is hidden only because triageEnabled=false. The research flow is wired the same way (fixed participant, TSB 14.2, card VERIFIED, export never runs, R08/R09 placeholders). The engines themselves are well tested. The test reports in docs/test-reports cannot be relied on: v0.5.md (committed 2026-10-20 15:56) reports TC-SYNC-01..14 and the server checks TC-SEC-11..13 as passed before the sync client (2026-10-25) and deploy stack (2026-10-24) existed. It also reports TC-CARD-10 (print batch) as passed. v1.0.md reports TC-USE-03 as passed while BANGLA_STRINGS_REVIEW.md is a draft. Its clinical lead APPROVED rows conflict with the placeholder in CLINICAL_SIGNOFF.md. For these reasons physical milestone criteria are marked Unknown, not Implemented. Inventory head 4f04aef differs from audited commit 4523908; product code is stated to be identical. Test counts are from reports/direction/2026-10-26/trace.txt.
